title: Preservation of well-formedness
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $m+n$ input bits in which each gate has distinct arguments and every NOT gate has exactly one argument. For any assignment to the first $m$ inputs, the circuit obtained by hardwiring those inputs also has distinct arguments at each gate, and every NOT gate in it has exactly one argument.
